new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Business Bay?
Private dining in Business Bay starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of Business Bay do you serve?
All of Business Bay — Dubai Canal apartment towers, Executive Towers and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included?
We handle the menu, the chef, the service team, the plating and the full cleanup afterwards.
Can you cater a dinner party in a Business Bay apartment?
Yes — apartment and penthouse dinners are the most common booking here. Your chef cooks in your own kitchen, serves each course and cleans up, working cleanly and quietly in a shared tower.
Do you offer halal and dietary menus?

Yes. Every menu can be prepared fully halal, and vegetarian and vegan versions are available on request. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Is there a minimum number of guests?
No fixed minimum — we cater intimate dinners for two as readily as large celebrations. Smaller tables are priced a little higher per head because one chef still cooks the full menu.
Can I request a female private chef in Business Bay?

Yes. A female chef can be requested for your booking. Tell us when you enquire and myCHEF brings you a female chef from the partner network for your date, cuisine and service style. In a Business Bay apartment the kitchen is usually part of the living space, so hosts who want privacy at home, and anyone planning a women-only celebration, often ask for it. Raise it with your first enquiry rather than later: availability depends on the date and the cuisine, and we confirm the match before you book.
How do I book?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Is there an affordable way to book a private chef in Business Bay?

Yes, and headcount is the biggest lever. Everything is priced per head, so a table of two carries the whole cost of one chef's evening at AED 950–1,300 per person, six guests bring it to around AED 750–1,000, and ten or more start from AED 700. Service style is the second lever: a relaxed buffet or a shared-plate menu costs less per head than a plated tasting with dedicated service staff. The cheapest version of this is not a smaller evening, then — it is a slightly bigger table with a relaxed format.
Can I book a full time private chef in Dubai?

Not as an employment placement. MyCHEF arranges bookings rather than staffing contracts, so we do not put a full time private chef on a household payroll. What we do run is the regular version of the same thing: a recurring chef on a fixed night each week, or weekly meal prep cooked and portioned for your fridge, kept with the same chef where their diary allows. For most Business Bay households that covers what a full-time chef would, without the contract.
For private chef business bay, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Why choose myCHEF in Business Bay?
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. No chef is offered for private chef business bay before clearing identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews — a continuous standard, not a one-time tick. We are honest about it, too: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the best available chef for it, which is what a genuinely luxury private chef Business Bay service should mean.

For a Business Bay occasion — often corporate entertaining or a refined apartment dinner — that might be Ahmed Al-Rashid , 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique. He designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and served to exacting standards. We have delivered corporate galas and boardroom dinners across Dubai. Client reviews are added as events are delivered — real feedback only, not fabricated — so the best private chef Business Bay for your night is chosen on merit.
